rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timestamp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded with a timestamp for each entry, but not necessarily ordered or at specific intervals, such as when a taxi ride starts and ends.
Provides information about the content type of an Element or a property.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM provides an inventory of software that is present on a system. This may be an assembly of other SBOMs that combines analysis of configuration options, and examination of execution behavior in a (potentially simulated) deployment environment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kilowattHour
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Kilowatt-hour.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isci
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: International Standard Collection Identifier (ISCI) is a variable-length identifier standardized by [ISO 27730](https://www.iso.org/standard/44293.html) for identifying collections held by libraries, archives, museums, and other memory institutions. It consists of two parts: the identifier for the assigning organization (an ISIL) enclosed in square brackets, followed by a local collection identifier string (e.g., `[FR-751041001]Casadesus1`).
The assessment of the state of a requirement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasResolution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /SupplyChain/ResolutionAction points to the `to` /SupplyChain/OutOfSpecAction that is addressed.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audit
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An examination typically focusing on compliance with policies, standards, or regulations. Usually this is done during an audit meeting, while the assessment also involves deep and detailed reviews of work products (e.g. requirements, verification specifications, reports etc.)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lexid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: LEX Identifier is a Uniform Resource Name (URN) for sources of law within the [LEX namespace](https://www.iana.org/assignments/urn-formal/lex), as defined in [RFC 9676](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9676/) (e.g., `urn:lex:it:stato:decreto.legislativo:2018-08-10;101`).
Products or commodities produced as a bulk unit are called bulk products. Commodities are often sold in bulk.
EvaluationResult is the result of an evaluation.
Abstract class representing a License or an OrLaterOperator.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a directory and all content stored in that directory.
Designates elements as products where the impact of a vulnerability is being investigated.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has other specific context information necessary to capture that the above set of enumerations does not handle.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/intendedUse](../../Core/Properties/intendedUse.md) instead.
The intended use of a given dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityOther
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to related security information of unspecified type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: buildMeta
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the build metadata related to a published package.
verificationMethod refers to the specific approach used for a checking an element's conformance with its requirements.
A probability score between 0 and 1 of a vulnerability being exploited.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/ElementCollection is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated as part of the process of building the software to create a releasable artifact (e.g., executable or package) from data such as source files, dependencies, built components, build process ephemeral data, and other SBOMs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: providesSupportFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent provides support for each `to` Artifact. The use of the `providesSupportFor` type is constrained to `SupportRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasHost
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Build/Build was run on the `to` Element during a LifecycleScopeType period (e.g. the host that the build runs on).
A location where a package or an item is being picked up.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: limitedSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and there is limited support available from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the software support channel or other support information for a package.
Provides a CVSS version 2.0 assessment for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: operations
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Operations profile specification.
Dimensions generally refer to measurable extents or attributes that define the size, shape, or scale of an object, system, or concept.
The result of applying a hash algorithm to an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conditionalAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 3 - Conditional automation. The system can propose strategies and then automatically execute the approved plan, with an external agent being ready to take over when necessary.
A specification type defines the nature of a specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verificationUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a verification management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify a verification item.
typeFromSource is a value used to define an item within the definitionSource.
RoleRelationship represents a relationship between an entity holding a role and the scope or context in which that role applies. The givenRole property specifies the role assigned.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: high
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The second-highest level of risk posed by an AI system.
An entity that is authorized to issue identification credentials.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md4
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD4 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1186](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1186/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: model
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a machine learning or artificial intelligence model.
The physical mass of a hardware component.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sil4
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Safety Integrity Level 4 under IEC 61508.
Energy consumed when finetuning the AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: yes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates presence of the field.
Information related to virtual hardware simulation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: observation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Documentation of direct monitoring or witnessing of the demonstration of processes, tests, or any kind of system responses during a specified timeframe under specified environmental conditions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: coordinatedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability is coordinatedBy the `to` Agent(s) (vendor, researcher, or consumer agent).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: webpage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that can be used to locate a resource, as defined in [RFC 9110](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9110/) Section 4.2.1 or Section 4.2.2. It may include an optional fragment identifier as specified in [RFC 3986](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3986) Section 3.5.
A License participating in an 'or later' model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dynamicAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a dynamic analysis report for a package.
Class that describes a physical instance of Hardware.
Specifies the type of the external reference.
Class that describes a build instance of software/artifacts.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A key validation protocol not covered by one of the other KeyValidationProtocolType.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 512, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element (the instructions) runs on each `to` /Hardware/Hardware (processing element), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
A planned location where a good, product, or material is inspected.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement that has verification (test, review, analysis etc.) details defined in the `to` /FunctionalSafety/RequirementVerification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: riskAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a risk assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directDownload
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available and can be downloaded directly.
A distinct unit representing a requirement, as used in systems, software, and hardware engineering.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a bill of materials.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasProvidedDependency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a dependency on each `to` Element, dependency is not in the distributed artifact, but assumed to be provided, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Points to a resource outside the scope of the SPDX 3 content that provides additional characteristics of an Element.
A distinct article or unit related to Software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: development
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during development phase of an element.
Specifies the CVSS qualitative severity rating of a vulnerability in relation to a piece of software.

referenceSpecification provides a reference to a DefinedType that defines the specific meaning, structure, and semantics of a Role. It connects the role to its authoritative source definition, ensuring consistent interpretation across different contexts.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/endTime](../../Core/Properties/endTime.md) instead.
Property that describes the time at which a build stops.
Provides information about the type of an SBOM.
Agent represents anything with the potential to act on a system.
A collection of Elements, not necessarily with unifying context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 256, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseHistory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published list of releases for a package.
Abstract class for the portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a license.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: act
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level and leadership-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, as well as publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. Typically, internal groups would meet to determine the overall response and then execute agreed upon actions. CISA recommends remediating Act vulnerabilities as soon as possible.
A location where a package or an item will be picked up.
Abstract ancestor class for all vulnerability assessments.
The record of destruction is entered in this action.
A state is an instance that describes what a system, component, subsystem, process, or project has achieved at any given time.
Street address includes a street number, name and unit ID to identify a specific street.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidenceUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a reporting management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify an evidence relationship item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: chat
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the instant messaging system used by the maintainer for a package.
Specifies a time when a vulnerability assessment was modified

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha1
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-1, a secure hashing algorithm, as defined in [RFC 3174](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3174/).
roleQualification specifies the requirements, criteria, or conditions that must be met for an entity to be considered qualified to fulfill a particular role.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/Location is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A verificationUID is a unique identifier assigned to a Verification item.
Enumeration of verification types.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: metrics
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to metrics related to a package such as OpenSSF scorecards.
Assessment of an Element for export control classification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: high
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 7.0 - 8.9.
Specifies the SPDX License List version in which this license or exception identifier was deprecated.
Identifies the tooling that was used during the creation of the Element.
A QUDT (Quantity, Unit, Dimension and Type) unit applied to measurement criteria based on product type, region, and use.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Business Identifier Code (BIC), also known as SWIFT-BIC or SWIFT code, is a unique 8 or 11-character alphanumeric code standardized by [ISO 9362](https://www.iso.org/standard/84108.html) to identify financial and non-financial institutions (e.g., `BBWCUS33`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: privacyAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a privacy assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element expands out as an artifact described by each `to` Element.
Confidentiality level of the data points contained in the dataset.
An Individual Value for License where the SPDX data creator determines that no license is present.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: orcidid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) iD](https://info.orcid.org/what-is-orcid/) is a unique identifier for authors and contributors in scholarly communication; as a subset of the International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI), it typically appears as a URI such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`.
The destruction process is defined in this process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: copiedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been copied to each `to` Element.
A collection of SPDX Elements that could potentially be serialized.
A contact point from an Artifact to an Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: productMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional product metadata such as a reference within an organization's product catalog.
A canonical, unique, immutable identifier.
Provides an independently reproducible mechanism that permits verification of a specific Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence with an upper level requirement. Typically done as peer review, offline review or review meeting.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reportedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was first reported to a project, vendor, or tracking database for formal identification by each `to` Agent.
A Package that contains AI software or an AI model.
Provides a CVSS version 3 assessment for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iswc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Musical Work Code (ISWC)](https://www.iswc.org/iswc) is an 11-character unique identifier standardized by [ISO 15707](https://www.iso.org/standard/83125.html) for musical works (compositions) as distinct from specific recordings. While the "ISWC" label and grouping separators (dots and hyphens) are used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `T0017812031`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sil1
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Safety Integrity Level 1 under IEC 61508.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: obsoleted
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Superseded or not valid at present.
Unit of energy consumption.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: application
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software application.
A evidenceUID is a unique identifier assigned to an entity, item, or requirement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: incomplete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known not to be exhaustive.
Class that describes an instance of VirtualHardware.
CreationAction represents an event of product creation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssociatedVulnerability
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to associate a `from` Artifact with each `to` /Security/Vulnerability.
Provide context for a relationship that occurs in the lifecycle.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sensor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded from a physical sensor, such as a thermometer reading or biometric device.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: usesTool
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element uses each `to` Element as a tool, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Specifies whether the License is listed as approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when the type does not match any of the other options.
A specification is a detailed description of the design, requirements, or features of a product, process, or system.
Identifies from where or whom the Element originally came.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isan
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN)](https://www.isan.org/about/#what_is_isan) is a unique 24-digit hexadecimal identifier for audiovisual works standardized by [ISO 15706](https://www.iso.org/standard/83124.html). The ISAN remains persistent for a work regardless of its distribution format or its use. To facilitate human readability, the "ISAN" label, grouping hyphens, and two check characters are included (e.g., `ISAN 0000-0000-3A8D-0000-Z-0000-0000-6`); however, these elements shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `000000003A8D000000000000`).
A product specification (product spec) is a detailed document that outlines the technical, functional, and design requirements of a product.
A reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content related to an Element.
Describes one a profile which the creator of this ElementCollection intends to conform to.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [customIdToLicense](./customIdToLicense.md) instead.
Maps a "LicenseRef-" string for a custom license or a "AdditionRef-" string for a custom license addition to its URI identifier.
**NOTE:** This property is deprecated and only included for backward compatibility. New documents should use [customIdToLicense](./customIdToLicense.md) instead.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Extension/Extension is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment:
**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/version](../../Core/Properties/version.md) instead.
Identify the version of a package.
Provides a reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.
Sets the context for an assessment by specifying the related project.
Class that describes an instance of Hardware.
A value used in a key-value pair with a generic key that refers to an Element
Enumeration of valid profile identifiers.
A string containing the template format used to structure interactions with the AI model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandedLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the ExpandedLicensing profile specification.
EvidenceType refers to categories of documented or observable proof used to verify compliance, qualification, or performance
Provides a CVSS version 4 assessment for a vulnerability.
A buildId is a locally unique identifier used by a builder to identify a unique instance of a build produced by it.
The category describes the hardware item in a DefinedType.
A property name with an associated value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerabilityDisclosureReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Vulnerability Disclosure Report (VDR) which provides the software supplier's analysis and findings describing the impact (or lack of impact) that reported vulnerabilities have on packages or products in the supplier's SBOM as defined in [NIST SP 800-161 Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices for Systems and Organizations](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/161/r1/final).
Use Process defines actions used by elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altWebPage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an alternative web page.
Inspection Process defines specific various processes needed to satisfy the inspection requirements for a specific product or service.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: resolved
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` /SupplyChain/OutOfSpecAction is resolved in the `from` /SupplyChain/ResolutionAction.
Specifies the CVSS base, temporal, threat, or environmental severity type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: functionalSafety
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the FunctionalSafety profile specification.
This is the agent that performed the act of destroying the item.
A tuple of two positive integers that define a range.
Records the time when a recommended action was communicated in a VEX statement to mitigate a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eolNotice
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the End Of Sale (EOS) and/or End Of Life (EOL) information related to a package.
A Package that contains a dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: install
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is used to install software on disk.
Text specifying a province or state.
Provides functional safety context for an existing lifecycle-scoped relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: createdBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Action or DefinedProcess is createdBy `to` Agent(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 4.0 - 6.9.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: active
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: In use.
responsibilityCategory classifies the nature or domain of a responsibility transfer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inspection
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A thorough examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence. An inspection needs to have a defined set of acceptance criteria (e.g. a checklist), a documentation of roles involved in the inspection (e.g. to document the inspector's independence) and a clear documentation of when and how it was performed.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for support.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a single file (default).
Provides an exploit assessment of a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contains
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element contains each `to` Element.
The version of the SPDX License List used in the license expression.
The percentile of the current probability score.
The AssemblyProcess represents the process of creating a product by assembling a set of components, potentially in a way that allows for at disassembly (at least partially).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasEvidence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is considered as evidence for the `from` Element (`from` hasEvidence `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's testing phase, during development.
Specifies the time an artifact was released.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: No assertion is made about the safety integrity level.
A concrete subclass of AnyLicenseInfo used by Individuals in the ExpandedLicensing profile.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: finetunedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been finetuned on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseNotes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the release notes for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endOfSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is a defined end of support for the artifact from the supplier. This may also be referred to as end of life. There is a validUntilDate that can be used to signal when support ends for the artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assumes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element assumes each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption.
A license expression participating in a license set.
Provides the location of an external reference.
Specifies the time an artifact was built.
A name used in a CdxPropertyEntry name-value pair.
A standard with which the artifact complies.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exploitCreatedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability has had an exploit created against it by each `to` Agent.
A key with an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analyzed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through analysis of artifacts (e.g., executables, packages, containers, and virtual machine images) after its build. Such analysis generally requires a variety of heuristics. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as a "3rd party" SBOM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: track
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability does not require action at this time. The organization would continue to track the vulnerability and reassess it if new information becomes available. CISA recommends remediating Track vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: megajoule
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Megajoule.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: qm
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Quality management level.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to store extra information about an Element which is not part of a review (e.g. extra information provided during the creation of the Element).
Links a vulnerability and elements representing products (in the VEX sense) where a fix has been applied and are no longer affected.
The action of product use.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Software Composition Analysis (SCA) report.
A prescribed change to a product's location.
The product lifecycle phase, the requirement is applicable for.

givenRole is a property that specifies the role being assigned in a RoleRelationship. It links the relationship to an instance of the Role class, defining the function, responsibility, or position that the source element confers upon the target element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cycle
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Simulation architectures with precise cycle-level accuracy.
Provides a set of values to be used to describe the common types of SBOMs that tools may create.
Specifies the algorithm used for calculating the hash value.
A collection of Elements that have a shared context.
It is the authoritative or credible entity, document, or body of knowledge that provides the meaning of a type, ensuring accuracy, context, and standardization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: structured
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is stored in tabular format or retrieved from a relational database.
A map of Element identifiers that are used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where all elements apply.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conformsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element conforms to each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption or Specification.
A container for a grouping of SPDX 3 content characterizing details (provenance, composition, licensing, etc.) about a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDependencyManifest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has manifest files that contain dependency information in each `to` Element.
Records the biases that the dataset is known to encompass.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supplyChain
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SupplyChain profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clear
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Unlimited. Subject to standard copyright rules, the dataset may be shared freely, without restriction.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and is supported from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.
Regulation represents a rule or directive maintained by an authority.
Identifies who or what created the Element.
An actual change to a product's location.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdversaryModel
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the security adversary model for a package.
The name of the recipient expressed in text.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: source
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM created directly from the development environment, source files, and included dependencies used to build a product artifact.
Assessment of an Element for export control classification.
A physical location is a tangible, geographically identifiable place where objects, people, or assets exist or operate.
This is how the currentState of an affected Element is found.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rorid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Research Organization Registry (ROR) identifier](https://ror.org/about/) is a unique identifier for research and funding organization, typically expressed in its preferred URI form such as `https://ror.org/02mhbdp94`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: In addition to being supported by the supplier, the software is known to have been deployed and is in use. For a software as a service provider, this implies the software is now available as a service.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hardware
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Hardware profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gitoid

A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).
